pipeline.purpose: Owner reference target and no-fake-visual-green laws are fixed before implementation.
Colors, font scale, spacing, radii, glows, metal trim and red accent intensity are centralized.
Nav, Header, HUD, Command Rail, Operational Law, Organ Card, Aquarium, Buttons are separate components.
Lightweight SVG ornaments/frames/medallions are created as reusable assets; no giant screenshot chassis.
Screenshot evidence, layout metrics, deduplication, readability and Owner review are collected.
npm build, cargo check, Tauri dev and FPS proof are lower gates after live UI implementation.
Only Owner can close visual target as accepted.
